data.name: Gunhilda
data.gender_notes: Gunhilda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Germanic elements 'gunth' meaning battle and 'hild' meaning warrior, Gunhilda is a name of Germanic origin that translates to 'battle warrior' in English. The name Gunhilda carries the meaning “Battle warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Gunhilda usually hope their child will grow to embody battle warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Gunhilda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Battle warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gunhilda total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: גונחילדה
in_hebrew.meaning: מלחמת הקרב הקדושה נשמתה של אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גונחילדה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו במלחמת הקרב הקדושה, נשמתה של אלוהים, ומשמעותו לוחמת רבת עוצמה עבור אלוהים, שילוב של 'גון' שפירושו מלחמה, ו'חילד' שפירושו ילדה או צעירה, ומדגיש את הדבקות וההקרבה לנושא הרוחני.

in_greek.name: Γκουνχίλδα
in_greek.long_meaning: Γκουνχίλδα προέρχεται από τους Γερμανικούς όρους 'gun' που σημαίνει πόλεμος και 'hild' που σημαίνει μάχη ή πολεμίστρια, αναφερόμενη στη δύναμη και το πάθος για το θείο, και συνδέεται με την πνευματική αγωνία και την αφοσίωση στο Χριστό.

in_latin.name: Gunhilda
in_latin.long_meaning: Gunhilda derivatur ex terminis Germanicis 'gun' quod significat bellum et 'hild' quod significat proelium vel bellatrix, referens ad fortitudinem et devotionem ad divina, et coniungitur cum spirituali certamine et dedicatione ad Christum.

in_english.name: Gunhilda
in_english.meaning: Warrior of the sacred battle, devoted soul of God
in_english.long_meaning: Gunhilda originates from Germanic terms 'gun' meaning battle and 'hild' meaning fight or warrior, signifying a powerful fighter for God, and connects to spiritual struggle and dedication to Christ. It reflects strength, devotion, and a deep sense of spiritual commitment.

data.cultural_impact: Gunhilda is a name with deep roots in Germanic and Christian culture. Historically, it was used to honor the strong and fearless women of the medieval period, particularly warriors and protectors of the faith. In many tales and legends, Gunhilda is depicted as a defender of her people and a champion of justice.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Gunhilda holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the strength and courage that comes from faith. The name represents the spiritual warrior within each of us, called to defend our beliefs and stand strong in the face of adversity. It is a name that inspires us to be fearless in our faith and to leverage our inner warrior to overcome challenges and protect those around us. Furthermore, the name Gunhilda can serve as a reminder that all believers are called to be protectors of their faith, and that the strength and courage of one person can make a profound difference in the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Gunhilda: Strong in battle, shield of battle. A courageous and determined warrior in the service of God.

historical_references.reference: Gunhilda was a Frankish princess, the daughter of Clovis II, King of the Franks and his wife Clotilde. She was born around 632 and died around 680. She is best known for her role in the early medieval legends of the Frankish princesses known as the Merowingian legend, which portrayed her as a powerful and independent woman who ruled her duchy with authority.

According to legend, Gunhilda was married to Thierry II, Duke of Austrasia, whom she is said to have ruled jointly with after his death. She is also said to have taken charge of her sons' education and ruled Austrasia as regent for them until they came of age. The legends portray Gunhilda as a powerful and wise ruler, who was respected by her subjects and feared by her enemies.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Gunhilda is of Norse origin and translates to 'Battle Bold'. It is increasingly popular as a name for female characters in various media, particularly in those that explore Norse mythology, such as MMORPGs like World of Warcraft, and historical fiction series like Assassin's Creed. Gunhilda is also a frequent subject of podcasts and scholarly articles that delve into Norse mythology and the roles of female warriors in ancient cultures.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Gunhilda, a minister in Rome, Italy, shares that their name Gunhilda meaning "Battle warrior" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
